quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.20 (29 May 2015; Fan-wiki, and the SkyVu Facebook post seen in a fan frame); 150,000 Joules, level 10; sold in the Loud & Proud and World Cup 2015 bundles; once healed, no longer does (undated); 2026 status unknown
quickref.look: Official Loud & Proud bundle art: a giant orchid-pink Huggable (#F273F5, highlights #FCC3FC) with a tan head band (#D9CCB2), round plum eyes and an open grin, towering over B-1000; even the cropped head is more than 3x B-1000's head width; white-lilac lightning; lime background. In game (2.25 fan screenshot): a high, steep camera over a black Old-Timey-skin Huggable with its radio, consistent with a giant; multiplier unverified
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Tap to grow for 4 s (recharge 6 s); bigger melee hitbox; the user is slowed (wiki: 25%; a yellow 'Z' with curved white arrows is observed over the giant's head); no projectile, foot stomps make AoE shockwaves (20-40 explosive damage per wiki)
quickref.impact_end_result: A flat, glowing ground ring with straight edges around the giant: yellow core #F3F32B, orange band #F3950E, lime rim #BCF61C (one fan frame; its link to SSM is inference); a nearby enemy also wears the yellow 'Z' (cause unverified); fits BBG's octagon-shockwave family (Metal Crush, Steam trailer 52.9-53.7 s, 2013 footage [Inference, strong]); kill look unverified

quickref.status: Default since the BBR Gear Up (Oct 2012) and through BBG; 2.6 changed duration 3 to 5 s, infobox now says 4.0 s, recharge 7 s; no post-death spin since v2.2; seen in the Steam trailer at 7.2-8.5 s (the Graham segment, 2013 footage [Inference, strong]); no confirmed 2026 shot
quickref.look: Flat, flat-shaded ribbon about 3/4 of the Huggable's head wide, six solid stripes outer to inner: red #C22024-#FD5F4B, orange #DA6542-#FB9866, yellow #DDD426-#FEFE44, green #49BC21-#68FE54, sky blue #4B9BB7-#69EDFE, violet #432C70-#5E2FD1; curves made of straight segments; no glow rim in game (the green rim is card-only); orbit at hip height about 2.4-3x the Huggable's height across (about 1.5-2x Oliver)
quickref.firing_and_projectile: One tap, centred on the user; two rainbows spin around it for about 4 s and shrink at the end; melee cancels it; no projectile
quickref.impact_end_result: Continuous explosive-type area damage per second (45-90, falloff, +Explosions+); no frame shows the contact effect (hit FX unverified); kills nearby are intact face-down ragdolls seen from BBG's overhead death camera, one with a small yellow-white sparkle squiggle on the ribbon; no confetti or stuffing observed

quickref.status: BBG 2.2 (21 Aug 2013); still in 2014 footage; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: No launcher. The Huggable fires from an empty, open paw (the raised-arm pose is its general in-game idle). Menu and HUD icon: a white Huggable face followed by three grey copies, labelled PHANTOM HUG EQUIPPED, with SPEED +5% in the 2.2 menu [Observed]. The CANDY! box in thumbnails is the Gummable skin, not the weapon [Observed + Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Single shot, reload 5 s [Fan-wiki]. A small pale pink-white Huggable-shaped ghost trailed by 2-3 hollow pink rings (#F87B99 to #F99AF6). Seen head-on it is a white-hot silhouette with pink outlines (#E3AEDB, core #F7FFFF). A full-size bright magenta 'clone' (#F19ACE) can stand briefly beside the user [Observed; clone reading is Inference].
quickref.impact_end_result: A soft pink-white cloud flares on the target (#F29DD4 to #FFD3FF). The victim is frozen about 2.5 s [Fan-wiki] under a yellow block Z (#FDFC04) with two white crescent arrows, with a glowing pink ring around its waist (#CB9FC3, highlights #EFA3FF) and pink ghost arms. It can still be meleed (yellow stars). Violet rings (#5748C7 to #8F75D8) drift afterwards. No damage [Fan-wiki].

quickref.look: No model. The head itself is the bomb; the Gear Up uses the normal stance [Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: The Huggable shakes its head off; it lands at its feet and explodes almost at once [Fan-wiki]. The drop is not caught in any storyboard frame.
quickref.impact_end_result: A large spherical bright-blue blast enveloping the Huggable [Fan-wiki]. Three LYH-titled clips show the screen flooded cyan (#2FFDF9 to #78FDFC) with a curved sphere edge and a kill popup [Observed; attribution Inference]. A new head appears afterwards [Fan-wiki].

quickref.look: No model; the Huggable itself charges and runs [Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Hold to charge while immobile, then run at 600 u/s for 1.5 s (4 s charged) [Fan-wiki]. In two 2.6 clips a yellow Z with white crescent arrows hovers over the user's own head for at least 5 s, with green streaks around its body (#3C9857 to #7CB980) [Observed]. That this marks charge immobility is Inference. The run itself was not captured.
quickref.impact_end_result: 40 damage once per opponent run through [Fan-wiki]. Hit visuals cannot be told apart from melee stars [Unverified].

quickref.status: BBR 1.4.3 (Apr 2013) to BBG (still in 2.25, 2016); not seen in 2026
quickref.look: No model. The head stays on in every frame that shows sparks [Observed]. The in-game BBR text was seen in fan footage.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: While charging, magenta-violet crackles wrap the body (#C852AA, #E847E3, #FA6EEB) [Observed; charge reading is Inference]. The shot is a short cyan-white electric burst (#36F9FD, #7FDBF0, #81FEFA) [Observed].
quickref.impact_end_result: The target is wrapped in cyan fizz (#54E2EC, #5BF3F4) [Observed]. Thin white-to-pale-cyan zig-zag lightning lines (#8ABEC9 to #ADD8E8) stay on the floor for several seconds [Observed], matching the wiki's lingering damaging particles.

quickref.status: BBR by Feb 2012 to BBG; only BBR footage examined; not seen in 2026
quickref.look: The head is absent while firing and back on afterwards in BBR footage (Dec 2012) [Observed, 116x90]. The rainbow bands come from the Gear Up card [Observed earlier].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A straight, head-thick beam from the neck to the target. At low resolution it reads warm peach to white with pink-orange edges (#F19262, #E2C871, #FFF8E5) [Observed].
quickref.impact_end_result: A yellow-white starburst at the beam's end (#FFF298, #FFF15D) [Observed]. A mint, yellow and gold ray burst on an airborne target (#80EDC6, #FFFCAB, #FFD24B) is a probable hit [Inference].

quickref.look: Gear Up card only: green ghost outlines shrinking to a small Huggable. In-game scale was not resolvable in the 120x90 storyboards [Unverified].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Same activation as Peek A Boo per the wiki, with a laughing sound [Fan-wiki]. No projectile.

quickref.status: BBR by Oct 2012 to BBG (outline removed in 2.6)
quickref.look: Gear Up card: a black silhouette with a neon outline in white clouds and bubbles [Observed earlier]. No in-game frame isolates it. The coffee mug over Huggables in 2.5 footage is Caffeine Injection [Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A short burst of rainbow energy above the Huggable, then invisibility [Fan-wiki]. No projectile.
quickref.impact_end_result: None on enemies; it ends on attack [Fan-wiki]. Pink-white clouds in a 2014 clip are unattributed [Unverified].

quickref.weapon: Gummable skin 'CANDY!' gum box (not a weapon)
quickref.status: Images uploaded Nov 2012 to Jan 2013; seen in BBG 2.2 to 2.25 fan footage
quickref.look: Glossy gummy body, red #FC0025 or blue #00AFEC by team. A pink-and-lime box (#EB4BCC, #E3F84D) reading 'CANDY!' with teal candies is strapped on the head, with a green-ball antenna [Observed + Fan-wiki].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: n/a: cosmetic. It was mistaken for a Phantom Hug launcher in earlier notes.
